messages:
miriam: Heads up — onboarding HF model 'big-chat-x' hit a weird conversion bug: optional Jinja blocks that render empty are being removed, and the final Redwood prompt loses the system marker. Repro attached below.
kevin: hmm can you paste the minimal template + rendered output?
sara: also callout: config.json for the model had mismatched special_tokens (added <|pad|> as unk) which may interact with the tokenizer. worth checking.
miriam: minimal repro:
```
# HF chat_template.jinja
{% if system_instructions %}
- role: system
  content: "{{ system_instructions }}"
{% endif %}
- role: user
  content: "{{ user_input }}"
```
Rendered with system_instructions == "":
```
- role: user
  content: "What is 2+2?"
```
Expected Redwood prompt must still include an explicit system sentinel (or an empty system role) so the runtime keeps role boundaries. But converter collapses the empty block and we end up with a prompt that starts with the user content only -> downstream kv-cache / role-prefix heuristics break.
kevin: oof. So the converter currently prunes empty sections completely. We should instead emit a sentinel like `<|system|>\n` when the system block renders empty.
sara: extra wrinkle: when quantizing, our tokenizer was concatenating the sentinel to the previous token for some model configs because `bos_token` and `sep_token` mapping in config.json were inconsistent. That created odd token merges after 4-bit quant and changed logits for the first tokens -> eval diffs.
eval-bot: CI run 2055123475: eval-harness/chat-flaky-tests reported:
- BERTScore delta: -0.011
- ROUGE-L delta: -0.007
- Top-1 token agreement drop at first 10 tokens: 6.2% (compared to baseline)
link: https://ci.redwood/run/2055123475 (summary attached)
kevin: quick fix proposal:
```
# converter pseudocode change
if block_exists and block_rendered == "":
    emit("- role: system\n  content: \"<|system_empty|>\"")
else:
    emit(rendered_block)
```
Also normalize special_tokens in config.json to include explicit `bos_token` and `additional_special_tokens` mapping before tokenizer init.
miriam: good plan. I'll push a patch to the converter (PR incoming) and kick a full eval run. If the sentinel approach reduces kv-cache misalignment we can then reconcile with a post-processing step that collapses the explicit sentinel for downstream human-visible text only.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy for converter patch at 2055123600 if CI green :rocket:
kevin: note for follow-ups — add a unit test that renders template with missing optional blocks and asserts presence of role sentinels, also add a tokenizer roundtrip test (encode->decode) for special tokens.
miriam: will do, tracking in PR. ETA running full regression by EOD.
